_DO_NOT_CITE: READ THIS BEFORE YOU USE ANY NUMBER FROM THIS FILE.

_README.what_this_is: A FIXTURE, not data. schemes.seed.json is almost entirely null because we do not yet have the official guidelines, and a null parameter makes the engine return NOT_COMPUTABLE by design. That is correct behaviour but it means nothing can be exercised — no golden tests, no personas CLI, no UI. This file supplies invented values for exactly those null slots so the machinery can be tested end to end.
_README.why_it_is_a_separate_file: So that no invented figure can ever be mistaken for a transcribed one. schemes.seed.json stays pristine: real guideline values drop into it and this file is deleted. If you find yourself copying a value from here into there, stop.
_README.authority: NONE. Every value below is arbitrary. Not one of them came from a scheme guideline, a rate card, or any document. They were chosen to be round and boring so that a hand-check on paper is easy.
_README.how_it_is_enforced: The loader in src/lib/dataset.ts sets figures_authoritative:false on every result computed with this overlay applied. The UI renders a permanent banner and every figure gets an unverified badge. There is a test (tests/dataset.honesty.test.ts) asserting that applying the overlay can never set figures_authoritative to true.
_README.when_to_delete_this_file: The moment data/schemes.seed.json has verified:true on all three schemes. Delete it, run the tests, and every number in the app becomes defensible.

_note_on_moratorium_treatment: The overlay deliberately does NOT override moratorium_interest_treatment. That field already has a placeholder value in the seed, and the three schemes happen to carry one of each treatment (MICRO=CAPITALISED, TERM=SERVICED, EDU=WAIVED), which means the personas run exercises all three code paths. That is a happy accident of the placeholder data, not a claim about the real schemes.
